about: Months and weekdays as the headings and short labels name them (spec/calendar.md, How days are written), with 月と曜日 in Japanese or, `english`, in English. For `day` ("YYYY-MM-DD"): weekdayLetter heads a column of days (木, T); weekdayName goes beside a date (木, Thu); weekdayHead heads a column that does not start the week (木, THU); monthTitle names a month alone (9月, September); monthWithYear with its year (2026年9月, September 2026); shortMonth in small text (9月, Sep); headingMonth is the calendar heading's English month, lower case and cut to three letters with a period unless it has no more (sep., may), and null in Japanese, where the heading writes the month's number before 月.

cases.name: a Thursday of September in English
a month of three letters keeps them all, with no period
a Saturday of December in Japanese
